findings.issue: Every Vyper range loop is rotated, as described for c00159: the first iteration is peeled before the loop (on_retract, on_propose, the weight updates) and the test reads 'idx + 1 != 6', or the in-body break test becomes the while condition and the range bound an 'if s + 1 != 32: continue / break' at the bottom; the loop variables live in memory words (mem[96], mem[448], mem[640]).
findings.rule: Same as c00159: recognise 'body; i = i + 1; if i != N: goto body' as one loop 'while i < N' (or i != N) without peeling; when a loop has two exits (a break test and the range bound), keep the range bound as the condition and print the other test as 'if ...: break'.
